entities.name: MonthlyTimelogReport
entities.description: Monthly aggregation of Jira worklog entries grouped by day and ticket.
entities.plain_language_summary: Aggregated report containing all daily time logs and the overall monthly logged hours for a selected calendar month.

attributes.name: month
attributes.description: Calendar month identifier in YYYY-MM format.

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Sum of all logged hours for the month formatted to 2 decimal places.

attributes.name: total_seconds
attributes.description: Sum of all logged time in seconds.

attributes.name: days_count
attributes.description: Count of days containing logged time in the month.

entities.name: DailyTimelog
entities.description: Daily breakdown of tickets and hours logged on a specific calendar day.
entities.plain_language_summary: A collection of ticket worklog items recorded by the user on a specific calendar date, including the day's total hours.

attributes.name: daily_total_hours
attributes.description: Total hours logged on this day formatted to 2 decimal places.

attributes.name: daily_total_seconds
attributes.description: Total seconds logged on this day.

entities.name: TicketWorklog
entities.description: Individual or aggregated worklog line item for a ticket on a particular day.
entities.plain_language_summary: A worklog entry recorded on a Jira issue representing time spent and work description for a given day.

attributes.name: summary
attributes.description: Description of work done from worklog comment or issue summary.

attributes.name: hours
attributes.description: Hours spent on this ticket for the day formatted to 2 decimal places.

value_objects.name: MonthSelection
value_objects.description: Selected year and month parameters for reporting query.
value_objects.plain_language_summary: The calendar month target (year and month) requested by the user.

value_objects.name: JiraCredentials
value_objects.description: Authentication configuration for connecting to Jira Cloud.
value_objects.plain_language_summary: Configuration holding Jira server URL, user email/username, and API token loaded from environment.

actions.name: FetchMonthlyTimelog
actions.description: Retrieves and processes monthly Jira worklogs for the current user.
actions.plain_language_summary: Query Jira for worklog entries matching the current user and month date range, aggregating them into daily and monthly summaries.

actions.name: SelectMonth
actions.description: User requests report for a different month.
actions.plain_language_summary: Change the active month filter to view worklogs for a preceding or succeeding calendar month.

state_enums.name: ReportLoadState
state_enums.description: Lifecycle state of the monthly report fetch and rendering operation.
state_enums.plain_language_summary: Lifecycle state of the monthly report retrieval process.

actors.description: Developer checking personal Jira logged hours for a calendar month.
actors.plain_language_summary: The user interacting with the web application to view logged hours.

observers.description: HTML+CSS single-page interface rendering daily worklog breakdowns and monthly totals.
observers.plain_language_summary: The web frontend UI that displays time logs, daily totals, and monthly aggregates.

alias_pairs.mapping_notes: Jira REST API returns timeSpentSeconds which maps to internal seconds field.
Jira started ISO timestamp truncated to YYYY-MM-DD.
Jira issue key field maps to domain issue_key.
Jira worklog comment plain text mapped to summary.

value_authorities.rationale: Jira is the authoritative upstream source for raw worklog logged seconds.
Daily total hours is computed locally from the sum of validated worklog seconds.
Monthly total hours is computed locally from the sum of daily totals.

fact_precedences.precedence_rule: Direct Jira Cloud REST API via HTTP client takes precedence; local jira CLI acts as fallback verification boundary.
fact_precedences.reconciliation_check: Compare aggregated (date, issue_key) seconds between REST API payload and CLI output.

entity_relationships.description: A monthly report contains zero or more daily timelog summaries.
Each day contains one or more ticket worklog entries.

entity_boundaries.name: Web Frontend Boundary
owned_invariants: Month total equals sum of daily totals
Daily total equals sum of ticket hours for that day

interfaces.description: Fetches monthly timelog data in JSON format from the backend service.
